title: 送错的包裹
summary: A mistaken package leads to a heartfelt surprise among three neighbors.
topic: A parcel delivered to the wrong apartment

blocks.hanzi: 小李住在五楼，一天晚上回家时，发现门口放着一个包裹。
blocks.translation: Xiao Li lives on the fifth floor. One evening when returning home, she found a package outside her door.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ zhù zài wǔ lóu, yī tiān wǎnshang huí jiā shí, fāxiàn ménkǒu fàng zhe yī gè bāoguǒ.

blocks.hanzi: 包裹上写的收件人不是她，而是三楼的张阿姨。
blocks.translation: The recipient written on the parcel is not her, but Aunt Zhang from the third floor.
blocks.pinyin: Bāoguǒ shàng xiě de shōujiànrén búshì tā, érshì sānlóu de Zhāng'āyí.

blocks.hanzi: 奇怪，快递员怎么把包裹放错门口了？
blocks.translation: Strange, why did the delivery person put the package at the wrong doorway?
blocks.pinyin: qíguài, kuàidìyuán zěnme bǎ bāoguǒ fàngcuò ménkǒu le?

blocks.hanzi: 小李拿起包裹，看到里面有一张纸条，上面写着张阿姨的名字和电话号码。
blocks.translation: Xiao Li picked up the parcel and saw that inside there was a note, on which was written Aunt Zhang's name and phone number.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ ná qǐ bāo guǒ, kàn dào lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ tiáo, shàng miàn xiě zhe Zhāng ā yí de míng zì hé diàn huà hào mǎ.

blocks.hanzi: 她决定先联系快递公司，问问能不能查到配送记录。
blocks.translation: She decided to first contact the courier company to ask if they could check the delivery record.
blocks.pinyin: tā juédìng xiān liánxì kuàidì gōngsī, wènwen néngbùnéng chádào pèisòng jìlù.

blocks.hanzi: 喂，您好，我收到一个包裹，但收件人不是我。您能查一下吗？
blocks.translation: Hello, I received a package, but the recipient is not me. Can you check it?
blocks.pinyin: wèi, nín hǎo, wǒ shōu dào yī gè bāo guǒ, dàn shōu jiàn rén bù shì wǒ. nín néng chá yī xià ma?

blocks.hanzi: 您好，我是快递员王明。这个包裹确实是我送错的。抱歉！我马上来处理。
blocks.translation: Hello, I am courier Wang Ming. This package was indeed delivered incorrectly by me. Sorry! I will handle it immediately.
blocks.pinyin: nín hǎo, wǒ shì kuàidìyuán wáng míng. zhège bāoguǒ quèshí shì wǒ sòngcuò de. bàoqiàn! wǒ mǎshàng lái chǔlǐ.

blocks.hanzi: 王明很快到了小李的门口，两人一起看了看包裹。
blocks.translation: Wang Ming quickly arrived at Xiao Li's door, and the two of them took a look at the package together.
blocks.pinyin: Wáng Míng hěn kuài dào le Xiǎo Lǐ de ménkǒu, liǎng rén yì qǐ kàn le kàn bāoguǒ.

blocks.hanzi: 这应该是三楼张阿姨的。我帮她送上去吧。
blocks.translation: This should be Aunt Zhang from the third floor. I'll help her deliver it up.
blocks.pinyin: zhè yīng gāi shì sān lóu zhāng ā yí de 。 wǒ bāng tā sòng shàng qù ba 。

blocks.hanzi: 等等，我认识张阿姨。她腿脚不太方便，不如我们一起送下去？
blocks.translation: Wait, I know Aunt Zhang. She has difficulty walking, so why don't we send it down together?
blocks.pinyin: děng děng, wǒ rènshi Zhāng āyí. tā tuǐ jiǎo bù tài fāng biàn, bù rú wǒ men yì qǐ sòng xià qù?

tokens.gloss: it would be better to; not as good as

blocks.hanzi: 于是两人一起下楼，敲响了张阿姨的门。
blocks.translation: So the two went downstairs together and knocked on Aunt Zhang's door.
blocks.pinyin: yúshì liǎng rén yīqǐ xià lóu, qiāo xiǎng le zhāng āyí de mén.

blocks.hanzi: 请进！哎呀，是小李和小王啊，有什么事吗？
blocks.translation: Please come in! Oh, it's Xiao Li and Xiao Wang, what's the matter?
blocks.pinyin: Qǐng jìn! Āiyā, shì Xiǎo Lǐ hé Xiǎo Wáng a, yǒu shénme shì ma?

blocks.hanzi: 张阿姨，您的包裹被送到五楼了，我送错了，真不好意思。
blocks.translation: Aunt Zhang, your package was delivered to the fifth floor. I delivered it wrong. I'm really sorry.
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng āyí, nín de bāoguǒ bèi sòngdào wǔlóu le, wǒ sòngcuò le, zhēn bùhǎoyìsi.

blocks.hanzi: 没事没事，谢谢你们帮我拿下来。快进来坐一会儿吧！
blocks.translation: It's okay, it's okay. Thank you for helping me take it down. Come in and sit for a while!
blocks.pinyin: méi shì méi shì, xièxie nǐmen bāng wǒ ná xià lái. kuài jìn lái zuò yīhuìr ba!

blocks.hanzi: 两人进屋后，张阿姨打开了包裹。里面是一条漂亮的围巾。
blocks.translation: After the two people entered the house, Aunt Zhang opened the package. Inside was a beautiful scarf.
blocks.pinyin: Liǎng rén jìn wū hòu, Zhāng āyí dǎkāi le bāoguǒ. Lǐmiàn shì yī tiáo piàoliang de wéijīn.

blocks.hanzi: 其实，这个礼物是给你准备的，小李。
blocks.translation: Actually, this gift is prepared for you, Xiao Li.
blocks.pinyin: qí shí, zhè gè lǐ wù shì gěi nǐ zhǔn bèi de, xiǎo lǐ.

blocks.hanzi: 给我？您为什么要送我礼物啊？
blocks.translation: Give it to me? Why are you giving me a gift?
blocks.pinyin: gěi wǒ？ nín wèishénme yào sòng wǒ lǐwù a？

blocks.hanzi: 上个月你帮我修好了手机，还经常帮我买菜，我一直想谢谢你。所以我在网上订了这条围巾。
blocks.translation: Last month you helped me fix my phone, and also often helped me buy groceries. I have been wanting to thank you. So I ordered this scarf online.
blocks.pinyin: Shàng gè yuè nǐ bāng wǒ xiū hǎo le shǒu jī, hái jīng cháng bāng wǒ mǎi cài, wǒ yī zhí xiǎng xiè xie nǐ. Suǒ yǐ wǒ zài wǎng shàng dìng le zhè tiáo wéi jīn.

blocks.hanzi: 小李很感动，她没想到自己小小的帮助会让张阿姨这么记在心里。
blocks.translation: Xiao Li was deeply moved. She didn't expect that her small help would be remembered so much by Aunt Zhang.
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hěn gǎndòng, tā méi xiǎngdào zìjǐ xiǎo xiǎo de bāngzhù huì ràng Zhāng Āyí zhème jì zài xīnlǐ.

tokens.gloss: Xiao Li (nickname for a young person surnamed Li)

blocks.hanzi: 张阿姨，您太客气了。邻里之间互相帮忙是应该的。
blocks.translation: Aunt Zhang, you are too polite. It is natural for neighbors to help each other.
blocks.pinyin: Zhāng āyí, nín tài kèqì le. Línlǐ zhījiān hùxiāng bāngmáng shì yīnggāi de.

blocks.hanzi: 哈哈，今天虽然是送错了包裹，但反而让你们更亲近了。
blocks.translation: Haha, although the package was delivered wrong today, it actually made you all closer.
blocks.pinyin: hā hā, jīn tiān suī rán shì sòng cuò le bāo guǒ, dàn fǎn ér ràng nǐ men gèng qīn jìn le.

blocks.hanzi: 三个邻居聊了很久，张阿姨还泡了茶，大家度过了一个愉快的傍晚。
blocks.translation: The three neighbors chatted for a long time, Aunt Zhang also made tea, and everyone had a pleasant evening.
blocks.pinyin: Sān gè línjū liáo le hěn jiǔ, Zhāng āyí hái pào le chá, dàjiā dùguò le yī gè yúkuài de bàngwǎn.
